'''Life Days Tinsel Bombs''' were explosive devices used in the celebration of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]]. When activated, they emitted a series of festive objects. During one particular Life Day celebration, they were sold along with the [[LD-1 Celebrator|Czerka LD-1 Celebrator]], the [[Life Day Holo-Tree]], the [[Life Day Orb/Legends|Life Day orb]] and [[Life Day robes/Legends|Life Day robes]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', December 2012 Life Day celebration</ref>
